messages.subject: Release 1.4.1
parts:
Release 1.4.1, 7 November 2013








  • New features in this release include:

(1) Release of binary distributions for Linux and Mac OS X operating systems. Both 32-bit and 64-bit machines are supported.
(2) featureCounts program automatically detects read input format (SAM or BAM) ('-b' option is no longer required for BAM input).
(3) Added option '--reportFusions' to subread-align program to detect fusion events such as chimeras in gDNA-seq data. Discovered fusions will be saved to a file. Detailed mapping results for fusion reads are also saved to the SAM/BAM output. Optional fields in the SAM/BAM file are used to store secondary alignments for each fusion read, along with the primary alignment stored in the main fields. Each fusion read occupies only one row in the SAM/BAM output.
(4) Added option '--allJunctions' to subjunc program to detect non-canonical exon-exon junctions (donor/receptor sites different from GT/AG) and also fusions in RNA-seq data.
(5) Bug fixes.

Enjoy it.

The Subread team
